subject: Crash as data size increases -- memory problem?

messages.author: 4e78013477145d7d
messages.subject: Crash as data size increases -- memory problem?
parts:
I am testing a data set and using a gradually increasing number of data points. When I get high enough, I get an error which starts with

sh: line 1:   279 Bus error: 10           
'/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla' -b -s -v
'/var/folders/6x/yr38x5bn2b59lr8bn57t0w340000gn/T//RtmpYDyqeI/fileff229a68de/Model.ini' > /var/folders/6x/yr38x5bn2b59lr8bn57t0w340000gn/T//RtmpYDyqeI/fileff229a68de/Logfile.txt


I tried running INLA with verbose=TRUE and got no further information.

Is this simply memory running out, or is there more?

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Crash as data size increases -- memory problem?
parts:
Hi,

"Bus error: 10" indicates a memory protection error, so yes, lack of memory seems to be the reason.

Finn
